correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all five model equations, positive coefficients, nonnegative bounded histories, R0, and source Lyapunov derivative. At R0=1 the V term vanishes; every other term is nonpositive, and equality forces T=T0,C=C0,A=A0. On the largest invariant set T’=-beta*T0*V forces V=0, followed by V’=r*d2*I forcing I=0. With bounded positive invariant histories, LaSalle yields global attraction and Lyapunov stability. The infected characteristic equation (z+a)(z+b)-ab exp(-z*tau)=0 has F(0)=0 and F’(0)=a+b+ab*tau>0: a simple critical zero root, so no exponential-stability claim. This analytically establishes the endpoint rather than extending by continuity.
